page.overview:
Who is Elita-1?

Captain of the mines (formerly)|english=Elita-1|gender=Female|occupation=Head of the Miners (formerly) Second-in-Command of the Autobots|cluster=|japanese voice=Riho Yoshioka|english voice=Scarlett Johansson|kanji=|family=Primus}}Elita-1 is one of the two tritagonist from Transformers One. An Autobot and former miner, Elita was the former head of Energon mining crew, which she was then demoted to waste management. She was one of the four Cybertronians who sought out the Matrix of Leadership. By the end she was promoted to lieutenant under Optimus Prime's command.

Despite her lack of cog and transformation, Elita-1 was responsible and in charge of leading and commanding the miners in the underground Energon mines of Iacon City. It is shown that Orion Pax seem to have known for a long time, where he tried to talk to her and seemingly likes her as a friend despite Elita's disapproval. As captain of the mines and a tireless worker , she worked hard to maintain a spotless record because she was up for potential promotion to overseer.

While she leading the miners toward the mine, the tunnel they are mining began to collapse when Wheeljack accidentally causing an instability of Energon. Following protocol, Elita ordered all miners to evacuate. However, when Jazz became trapped by a boulder and Orion stop to help him, Elita ordered him to desist from saving him, follow protocol, and just get out of there, but he defied her orders. With the help of D-16, they barely managed to make it out of the collapsed tunnel, while she still bought them a little more time to escape by throwing in support beams to slow down the collapsing walls, resulting in damage to nearby machinery.

Subsequently, as a result of Orion saving Jazz's life, Elita is blamed for the mess and is unfairly fires by Darkwing, despite her having followed protocol, demoting her from her position to waste management, much to her chagrin. The demotion caused Elita to blame Orion for this and claim he ruined her life, even though Orion didn't intend for her to get fired. To make up for what happened to her, Orion tried to challenge up for himself against Darkwing for getting Elita fired by flipping him off while claiming that his finger can "transform", only for him to get D-16 punched in the face by the latter when he tries to save Orion from being hit and excuse their insubordination. Working in the waste management, Elita watched in disbelief as Orion and D-16 appeared on the monitors while they were competing in the Iacon 5000 race.

Also known as: Elita One, Elita, Ariel.
